checks: Repeated debug/release, compiled production mutant and restored hashes; see model.md#tests
cost: O(n) time, O(1) storage, no allocation. Checked i128 accumulation and u128 certificate sums. Quotient/remainder certification avoids overflow from multiplying L1 by100. Work budget bounds pairs; unsupported and uncertified domains fail with no hidden fallback.
description: Equal-length i64 arrays, positive u64 step and supported percent. Let qa=trunc(a/step)*step and ra=a-qa. Accumulate approximate sum qa*qb and E=sum(|qa|*|rb|+|qb|*|ra|+|ra*rb|). L1=sum|a*b|. Return only if E<=floor(percent*L1/100).
forward: Equal-length i64 arrays, positive u64 step and supported percent. Let qa=trunc(a/step)*step and ra=a-qa. Accumulate approximate sum qa*qb and E=sum(|qa|*|rb|+|qb|*|ra|+|ra*rb|). L1=sum|a*b|. Return only if E<=floor(percent*L1/100).
inverse: Changing both vector signs preserves exact and quantized products. Permutations preserve sums and L1 but may change checked intermediate-overflow behavior. Opposing equal products can produce value0 with positive absolute certificate; value0 also admits all-zero inputs. Scalar output cannot reconstruct vectors or cancellation structure.
limitations: Finite oracles do not establish universal accuracy
No performance measurement or automatic substitution
